title: Minimum Taps to Water Garden

monster.name: Hydration Titan
monster.title: Opener of Spanning Irrigation Taps
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum taps opened to irrigate garden interval [0, n]!

description: There is a 1D garden on the x-axis from 0 to `n`. There are `n + 1` taps at points `[0, 1, ..., n]`. The `i`-th tap can water `[i - ranges[i], i + ranges[i]]`. Return the minimum number of taps to water the whole garden, or -1 if impossible.
starterCode:
def minTaps(n: int, ranges: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minTaps(n: int, ranges: list[int]) -> int:
    max_reach = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, r in enumerate(ranges):
        left = max(0, i - r)
        right = min(n, i + r)
        max_reach[left] = max(max_reach[left], right)
    curr_end = farthest = taps = 0
    for i in range(n):
        farthest = max(farthest, max_reach[i])
        if i == curr_end:
            taps += 1
            curr_end = farthest
            if curr_end <= i: return -1
    return taps
hints: Convert each tap to interval [left, right], track max_reach[left] = right, then run Jump Game II.
